relevance_note: Case series of three Chinese pedigrees: 'Herein, we report eight patients with HA20 from three unrelated families in China', each with a TNFAIP3 variant.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and copied Table 1 row segments directly from the file (checked by eye against the table). Table 1 has patients as rows but no label column; rows were matched to the text's people by family, sex and ages: row 1 = P1 (onset 18, diagnosis 28); rows 2-4 = IV:14, V:22, V:26 (the three rows are identical, so the order of assignment does not change any value); row 5 = IV:1 (Family 2) (onset 9); row 6 = P2 (onset 15, diagnosis 35); row 7 = P3 (M); row 8 = IV:1 (Family 3) (onset 8, diagnosis 10). Table cells use an en dash '–' while the legend defines '-' as negative ('+, postive; -, negative.'); I treated the en dash as that defined symbol and quoted the legend. 'UN' (unknown) treated as not reported. Labels: P1/P2/P3 used for the probands (the paper also gives V:24, III:5, III:3); IV:1 occurs in Families 2 and 3, and III:3 in Families 2 and 3, so the Family 2 people get '(Family 2)' suffixes. Contradictions in the paper: (1) P1 genital ulcers: text 'recurrent oral and genital ulcers' vs Table 1 Genital ulcers '–' (checklist not reported); (2) P2 fever: text 'without recurrent fever' vs Table 1 row 6 Fever '+' (checklist not reported); (3) IV:1 (Family 2) fever: text 'recurrent fever' vs Table 1 row 5 Fever '–' (checklist not reported); (4) P3 autoantibodies: 'autoantibodies were all normal' vs positive anti-TG/anti-TPO and Table 1 anti-TG(+), anti-TPO(+) (checklist not reported); (5) P3 onset: text oral ulcers 'since the age of 10' vs Table 1 onset 15 (text value recorded); (6) A547T pathogenicity: Abstract 'validated to be pathogenic' vs Discussion 'pathogenic significance of A547T was indeed unknown' (both quoted); (7) P1 Table 1 Arthritis '+' while text says joint pain 'without joint swelling' (both recorded, not treated as contradiction). Not given rows: the literature-review patients (group-level only), the grandparents III:2/III:3 of Family 1 (mentioned only as cousins), and cousin V:10 and her son VI:7 (G6PD deficiency only, no HA20 features or TNFAIP3 testing). Father IV:13 is included as a described relative ('had no symptoms'; the proband's NOD2 variant is 'paternal'); no NOD2 variant row was made for him because the paper does not state it for him; his checklist is all not reported because 'no symptoms' is a global statement. Family 2 aunt II:3 and cousins III:3, III:4 refused gene testing, so they have no variant rows; cousins' sex not stated, so 'no vulva ulcers' was not used to exclude genital ulcers for them. P1's consanguinity left not reported: the paper says the grandmother (III:2) and maternal grandfather (III:3) were cousins, not the parents. Absences reported after treatment (e.g. 'did not exhibit fever, arthralgia, oral ulcers') were not recorded as excluded. Normal investigations as a whole (chest CT, biochemistry panel, urine analysis, 'Ig and complements') were recorded as written and do not exclude interstitial lung disease or other checklist items; normal CBC was taken to exclude cytopenia. Narrower absences (uveitis, arthritis/polyarthritis, folliculitis, abdominal pain, 'ocular symptoms') were not used to exclude the broader checklist items. P2 moderate anemia recorded as a feature, but checklist 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' left not reported because no autoimmune cause is stated. P3 checklist 'vasculitis' marked observed from 'Henoch-Schonlein purpura'; P3 checklist 'genital ulcers' observed from Table 1 '+' (text describes a perianal ulcer). Variant fields for relatives: zygosity for IV:14, V:22, V:26 taken from the Figure 1C legend about Family 1; inheritance for the Family 1 sisters left not reported (the paper names IV:14 as the proband's mother only); variant type and pathogenicity taken only from sentences naming the exact variant; functional evidence only for the probands. Transcript NM_006290 for Table 1-based rows comes from the Table 1 column header; P1's text gives NM_006290.4.
